decay.triggers: Changes to grant/validation, Chat send or turn lifetime, owner/version/coordinate semantics, preview/acceptance, provider adapter, TUI pin or verification fixtures.
decay.refresh: Rerun the affected behavioral gates at new production/input seals, including rebuilt release PTY for acceptance/focus changes.
decay.failure_policy: Downgrade dependent verification claims until refreshed; reject stale proposals rather than restoring old acceptance authority. Temporary artifact expiry requires rebuilding for a new binary-level claim.
